endpoint: Construct an additional strict class through an explicit rational bisection of the new MW17 parent, using its equation and generic sections alone.
population: All 60 induced K1,3 stars in the exact 27-edge intersection graph of the fifteen generic section lines in the certified quartic presentation. This list is fixed before computing star-quadric fibre splitting. Deduplicate identical quadrics exactly. Also retain the canonical base-line bisection as a control; its zero-fibre quadratic was preliminarily observed nonsplit.
input_boundary: Whitelist the quartic equation, plane cubic, residual base line, W quotient, fifteen line equations and their generic-core words from the construction certificate. Use the separately frozen family equation and generic sections for arithmetic. No public31 coordinates, quotient lifts or exceptional characters are input. The parent is retrospectively reconstructed; the test is not an outcome-blind parameter selector.
construction: Three pairwise skew section lines and a common transversal determine a quadric. When it is smooth, its residual quartic on the K3 has divisor 2H minus the four lines, arithmetic genus0 and fibre degree2. Check node/extra-component issues rather than assuming irreducibility. On the zero fibre, eliminate the conic-cubic intersection and divide the four prescribed generic points to obtain the residual quadratic. Test its splitting exactly. Only a class independently outside the whole generic subgroup can meet the endpoint; generic or reducible residuals do not count.
certification: A positive specialization needs exact point transport, norm and ideal-square certificates, strict local conditions at every bad prime and infinity, and good-prime character independence modulo all seventeen generic sections. The rational carrier equation must be derived from the family before asserting a condition on t. A rational intersection supplies global solubility; it does not establish a fourteen-dimensional mechanism.
failure: Retain every geometric status, rationality test and terminal failure. No new rank, extra class, general exclusion or class-creation condition is asserted from an incomplete stage. Active Agent1 search files and outputs are read-only.
